quotes.text: "The column picker should not be focused"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The positive focus check targets the last-column picker, but the later Assert.notEqual still queries th[is="tree-view-table-column-picker"] button. The migration removes that dedicated cell class. The negative check therefore does not identify the new picker and can reduce to comparing the active element with null. The Enter, Escape and context-menu steps remain separate source assertions; no failing run is reproduced.
title: The migrated header keyboard test keeps a stale selector in its negative focus check
